summary: Added Dashboards: build interactive charts over Arco projects, CSV files and SQL queries without code.
details: A new Dashboards card on Home opens your dashboards and four ready-made samples.
Drag charts from a library, pick fields from lists, and save your own widgets to the library for reuse.
One dashboard can read several projects at once and chart what changed between two valuations.
Clicking a bar or a cell filters the other charts on the page; every chart can also be shown as a table.
ArcBot can summarize what a dashboard shows and add or change charts from a chat request.
